vulnerability_patterns.description: Before the patch, index derived from ((*p) & (0x01 << bit)) was used directly to read image->colormap[index]. If the image colormap has fewer entries than the possible index value, the colormap access can read out of bounds. The patch blocks this by calling VerifyColormapIndex(image,index) before each colormap read.
trigger_conditions: In VerifyColormapIndex-related SUN decoding logic, index is assigned from bit extraction: index=((*p) & (0x01 << bit) ? 0x01 : 0x00).
The computed index is written to indexes[x+7-bit] and then used as image->colormap[index].
No VerifyColormapIndex(image,index) or equivalent colormap bounds validation occurs between index assignment and image->colormap[index].
The image colormap may not contain the computed index value, especially index 1 for a too-small colormap.
fix_patterns: Insert VerifyColormapIndex(image,index) after index computation and before image->colormap[index].
Apply the same validation in both the main 8-bit loop and the trailing partial-byte loop.
Treat the verifier call as a barrier protecting the subsequent colormap array read, not as a generic logging or formatting change.

suggestions: First-draft detector should anchor on q[...] = image->colormap[index] where index was recently assigned from ((*p) & (0x01 << bit) ? 0x01 : 0x00).
Require only local AST/CFG initially: index assignment, optional indexes[...] write, then image->colormap[index] read in the same loop body.
Do not make absence of VerifyColormapIndex(image,index) an overly broad global filter first; use it as a local non-dominance condition between index assignment and colormap read.
The strongest barrier is VerifyColormapIndex(image,index) immediately before image->colormap[index]; treat equivalent colormap-index validation as a secondary refinement.
The loop shape over bit and x+7-bit indexing is useful for precision but should be secondary; the primary sink is image->colormap[index].
Cross-file analysis is not needed for an initial detector because the patch-local mechanism is fully visible in coders/sun.c.

analysis_rationale: The diff adds VerifyColormapIndex(image,index) immediately after index is computed from input byte bits and immediately before indexes[...] assignment and q[...] = image->colormap[index] in both full-byte and remainder-bit loops. The dangerous patch-local sink is the array read image->colormap[index]; before the patch, index values 0 or 1 were consumed without verifying that the image colormap actually contains that index.
